svg.aria-label: FIG. 1. NVDA on Robinhood Chain around one 10:00 New York decision. On the left, on paper, the ten session closes and the current answer that a house model's prompt contains, one column per session. The seam is the first block at or after 10:00, where the prompt's data stops. Above the carbon side: once the model answers, its record is hashed with sha256 and sealed in a seal or trade transaction, the amber dot. On the right, on carbon, every round the feed posted after that block until the next session's 10:00, on a log time scale; none of them was read.
svg.title: FIG. 1 NVDA 2026-11-17
